services.desc: Looking to make the most of your time outdoors? Percy Priest Lake is a true Middle Tennessee gem, offering miles of shoreline, peaceful coves, and unforgettable views. At Four Corners Marina, we make getting out on the water simple and stress-free with one of the best selections of boat rentals in Nashville. Whether you’re planning a relaxing afternoon cruise, an adventurous day of tubing, or a laid-back outing with friends, our clean and comfortable fleet has the perfect fit-especially our popular pontoon boats on Percy Priest Lake.
